consumer_guide.document_identifier: Guide for safety of Electrical Appliances for Heating Liquids
consumer_guide.text: Common examples of appliances for heating liquids include Electric Kettle, Coffee-makers, Egg boilers, Electric Rice Cookers and Yogurt Makers. The Indian standard IS 302-2-15 deals with safety requirements for appliances intended to heat liquids.

paragraphs.text: IS No.: IS 302-2-15 : 2009. Title: Safety of household and similar electrical appliances: Part 2 particular requirements: Sec 15 Appliances for heating liquids (First Revision).

paragraphs.heading: Sampling Guidelines — Raw material
paragraphs.text: Raw Material and Components used in the product shall be tested as per relevant Indian Standard, wherever applicable.
The manufacturer declares the appliance type, model, ratings and capacity or size for each model.
For grant of licence or change in scope of licence, each model of each type of appliance is tested separately.
A tested model with a higher input rating may cover similar lower input rating models when other scope parameters remain the same.
Separate samples are tested for grant of licence or change in scope for cordless kettles.
For each model, the manufacturer declares appliance class, degree of protection, material group, pollution degree, and the instruction or operation manual with product photographs.

qco_2026.source_authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Government of India
qco_2026.document_identifier: Safety of Household, Commercial and Similar Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2026
qco_2026.gazette_reference: The Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II—Section 3(ii)
qco_2026.text: The Order supersedes the 2025 Order, applies within its stated voltage scope, comes into force on 1 October 2026, requires the Standard Mark under Scheme-1, lists Appliances for Heating Liquids, and sets implementation dates of 1 October 2026 for general enterprises, 1 January 2027 for small enterprises and 1 April 2027 for micro enterprises.

scheme_i.document_identifier: Scheme I (ISI Mark Scheme) compulsory certification list
scheme_i.text: The BIS Scheme-I compulsory certification list maps the Safety of Household, Commercial and Similar Electrical Appliances QCO instruments to IS 302 (Part 1):2024 and includes Appliances for Heating Liquids.
